summary: Build cloud cost allocation, unit economics, and optimisation skills with hands-on billing analysis. Explore the FinOps training course.
lede: FinOps training helps cloud engineers, finance business partners and IT leaders connect cloud usage with accountable spending decisions. Participants analyse provider billing data, build tagging and allocation models, calculate unit costs, and assess rightsizing and commitment options. They also review forecast variance and anomaly alerts, then develop showback or chargeback workflows and a cost-optimisation roadmap using the FinOps Framework and FOCUS.
audienceIntro: This FinOps training is designed for professionals responsible for cloud spend visibility, cost allocation, optimisation, or financial governance across AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud environments.
audience: Technology leaders in financial services, telecoms
modules: FOCUS Cost Data and Spend Visibility
prerequisites: Working familiarity with cloud services and basic billing concepts is recommended. Bring access to billing exports or reports from at least one cloud provider for practical analysis; coding is not required. Review any organisational rules for sharing billing data before the course.
